services.name: Manatees & Tours
services.desc: With guided tours taking off from right behind the Adventure Center, you can take a unique opportunity to swim with the majestic Crystal River, Florida manatees and - with proper precautions taken for their safety - practice passive observance, which helps you come face-to-face (or face-to-snout) with these one-of-a-kind marine mammals! As part of these Crystal River adventures, we provide detailed pre-tour education and instruction in our full-service facility, as well as snorkels and wetsuits for your use in the water. services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: With easy access from the canals behind Plantation Resort on Crystal River, there are hundreds of miles of rivers, creeks, bays, and springs waiting for you just outside the Adventure Center. Anglers and boaters seeking Crystal River hotels with a marina can paddle out, crank up the power motor, and spend the day drifting away, or cast sails into the sunset and pursue a prized catch with Crystal River FL fishing charters. Cruise straight into your Crystal River adventure. While guests are free to bring their own boats to Plantation Resort on Crystal River, the Adventure Center also offers a variety of boat rentals for your convenience. Charter your trip with ease at the Adventure Center!
